name: HardeningKitty
what: An open-source PowerShell module that audits Windows settings against finding lists (for example based on CIS or Microsoft baselines) and can apply settings.
when: To measure a Windows 11 or Windows Server build against a hardening baseline, before and after you deploy policies.
example: Download the module from GitHub and load it with `Import-Module .\HardeningKitty.psm1`.
Run an audit with logging and a CSV report: `Invoke-HardeningKitty -Mode Audit -Log -Report`.
Review failed findings in the report and decide which belong in your Intune or GPO baseline.
Deploy fixes through your normal policy tooling, then audit again to confirm.
pitfalls: The HailMary mode applies settings directly; use it only on test machines and take a backup first.
A backup of settings is not a full system restore.
Run audits elevated, or some checks cannot read their values.
